agencies.helpTooltip: Agencies group users and buildings under a single tenant organisation. Suspend an agency to block all logins immediately.
agencies.title: Agencies

announcements.helpTooltip: System-wide banners shown to all Property Management users. Set a start/end time to schedule announcements automatically.

audit.empty: No audit events match the current filters.
audit.helpTooltip: Every significant platform action is recorded here. High-severity events (purge, escalate, impersonation) also appear on the Dashboard.
audit.title: Audit Log

capabilities.helpTooltip: Capabilities are named permission flags. Grant carefully — some (tenant_purge, principal_kind_escalate) are irreversible and require MFA.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

featureFlags.helpTooltip: Feature flags take effect immediately for all users in the affected tenant. Use the kill switch with caution.
featureFlags.title: Feature Flags
featureFlags.warning: Per-tenant kill switch — changes take effect immediately for every user in this tenant.

dashboard.helpTooltip: Live overview of platform health, high-risk events, and active impersonation sessions. Refresh the page to update stats.

impersonation.helpTooltip: Active impersonation sessions are listed here. Every session start and stop is recorded in the audit log. Sessions expire after 1 hour.
impersonation.label: IMPERSONATING
impersonation.title: Active Impersonation Sessions

memberships.helpTooltip: Memberships link a user to an agency or building with a specific role. Revoking a membership takes effect on the user's next API request.
memberships.title: Memberships

mobile.helpTooltip: Remote config delivered to the mobile app on startup. Set min_version to force older builds to update before connecting.

mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.invalidCode: That code did not work. Try again.
mfa.invalidFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.label: Verification code

requiredToast.message: Please confirm with your authenticator app to continue.
requiredToast.title: Two-factor confirmation required

mfa.title: Verify your identity

oauthClients.description: Manage third-party OAuth 2.0 clients that can obtain tokens on behalf of your users. Capability required: oauth_client_write.
oauthClients.helpTooltip: OAuth clients allow third-party apps to obtain access tokens. Regenerate the secret immediately if it is compromised — old secrets are invalidated at once.

revokeDialog.body: This will permanently deactivate client {{name}}. Active tokens issued to this client will continue to work until they expire, but no new tokens can be obtained.
revokeDialog.confirmLabel: Type the client name to confirm:
revokeDialog.title: Revoke OAuth client

oauthClients.title: OAuth Clients

toast.registeredMessage: Save the client secret now — it won't be shown again.
toast.secretRegeneratedMessage: Save the new secret now — it won't be shown again.

oauthConsent.title: Authorize application
oauthConsent.lead: {{app}} is requesting access to your account.
oauthConsent.invalidRequest: This authorization request is invalid or incomplete.
oauthConsent.loadError: Could not validate the authorization request: {{message}}

onboarding.title: Onboarding Tours
onboarding.subtitle: Preview and manage step-by-step onboarding tours for platform users.
onboarding.helpTooltip: Onboarding tours guide new admin users through key workflows step by step.

health.helpTooltip: Real-time API server metrics and alerts. Auto-refreshes every 60 seconds. Acknowledge alerts to record your review in the audit log.
health.loadError: Failed to load health dashboard. Check your connection and try again.
health.title: Platform Health

platform.helpTooltip: Maintenance mode returns 503 to all non-admin requests. Enabling it requires an audit reason.
platform.title: Platform Settings

users.helpTooltip: Search by email or name. Use Change kind with care — it permanently alters how the user authenticates.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search users by email or name…
users.title: Users

transition.description: This will change how {{name}} authenticates and which capabilities they hold. Continue?
transition.title: Change principal kind

common.pleaseWait: Please wait while we fetch the details.
